page.content:
Caltech-managed NASA center that flies most planetary robots.

How Jet Propulsion Laboratory connects

  • Faction: Voyager program — JPL built and still operates the Voyager probes.
  • Faction: Mars Exploration Program — JPL runs NASA's Mars rover and orbiter campaign.
  • Topic: NASA — JPL is the Caltech-managed NASA center for robotic deep space.

What is Jet Propulsion Laboratory?

JPL in Pasadena designs and operates Voyager, the Mars rovers, and many deep-space missions, linking campus engineering to NASA's robotic program.
